title: Relative affine-space charts and base change
statement:
The affine charts in [def-nagata-relative-affine-space] glue to a
scheme over $S$. Their transition maps satisfy the cocycle condition,
and for every $T\to S$ there is a canonical isomorphism
$\mathbb A^n_S\times_ST\cong\mathbb A^n_T$ compatible with the charts.

proof.text:
On an affine $V=\operatorname{Spec}(R)$, localization gives
$R[T_1,\ldots,T_n]_a\cong R_a[T_1,\ldots,T_n]$. On a triple of principal
opens both composites send each polynomial coefficient to its image in the
localization at the product of the denominators, so the cocycle equality is
literal. Scheme gluing therefore produces the asserted scheme and map to
$S$. After base change to $T$, the same affine charts become
$\operatorname{Spec}(\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_T)[T_1,\ldots,T_n])$ on affine
$W\subseteq T$; the chartwise identifications agree on overlaps and hence
glue to the stated base-change isomorphism.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme and $n$ an index set.

1. For every affine open $V\subseteq S$ the chart
$\operatorname{Spec}\bigl(\mathcal O_S(V)[T_i:i\in n]\bigr)\to\mathbb A^n_S$
of [def-nagata-relative-affine-space] is an open immersion onto the preimage
of $V$, and these charts cover $\mathbb A^n_S$.
1. For affine opens $V'\subseteq V$ of $S$, the chart over $V'$ is the chart
over $V$ precomposed with the morphism induced by the restriction
$\mathcal O_S(V)[T_i]\to\mathcal O_S(V')[T_i]$, and these transition
morphisms satisfy the cocycle condition: for $V''\subseteq V'\subseteq V$ the
transition for $V''\subseteq V$ is the composite of those for
$V''\subseteq V'$ and $V'\subseteq V$.
1. For every morphism $g\colon T\to S$ there is a canonical isomorphism
$\mathbb A^n_S\times_ST\cong\mathbb A^n_T$ over $T$, compatible with the
charts: for affine opens $W\subseteq T$ and $V\subseteq S$ with
$g(W)\subseteq V$, the chart of $\mathbb A^n_T$ over $W$ corresponds to the
chart of $\mathbb A^n_S$ over $V$, after changing coefficients along
$g^\sharp\colon\mathcal O_S(V)\to\mathcal O_T(W)$, together with the
structure morphism to $T$.

proof.text:
(1) For an affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ of $S$, the base change of
$\mathbb A^n_S=S\times\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[T_i:i\in n]$ along the
open immersion $V\to S$ is
$V\times\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[T_i]=\operatorname{Spec}(R[T_i])$, and
the chart is the resulting projection. As a base change of an open immersion
it is an open immersion, and its image is the preimage of $V$. The affine
opens of $S$ cover $S$, so their preimages cover $\mathbb A^n_S$.

(2) Both composites are morphisms into the fibre product
$\mathbb A^n_S$ whose two components agree: on the factor $S$ both are
$\operatorname{Spec}(R'[T_i])\to V'\to S$, and on the factor
$\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[T_i]$ both are induced by
$\mathbf Z[T_i]\to R'[T_i]$. The cocycle condition holds already on rings,
since both composites send each polynomial to the polynomial obtained by
restricting its coefficients from $V$ to $V''$.

(3) The square with sides $\mathbb A^n_T\to\mathbb A^n_S$ (the base change
of $g$), the two structure morphisms and $g$ is cartesian by the pasting law
for fibre products, since both $\mathbb A^n_T$ and $\mathbb A^n_S$ are base
changes of $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[T_i]$; this gives the isomorphism.
The compatibility with the charts is again a comparison of the two
components of morphisms into a fibre product, both of which are induced by
the ring map $\mathcal O_S(V)[T_i]\to\mathcal O_T(W)[T_i]$ given by
$g^\sharp$ on coefficients.
